packageRules.description: requires-python follows the Python of the Home Assistant core the harness pins (core's .python-version), like ruff's target-version and mypy's python_version: moved by hand with the harness. Left to Renovate it tracks CPython releases, so uv tests on a Python Home Assistant doesn't run and the new floor excludes the one it does; CI stays green because core declares no upper bound.

pytest-homeassistant-custom-component is welded to one Home Assistant core version: its own PR, and a human merges it, because moving Home Assistant usually means moving the companion pins below by hand to the versions that core release requires.

Companions pinned to what the harness's Home Assistant core requires (hassil and the intents come from the conversation integration's manifest): they move with the harness, by hand, never to their own latest release.
